title: Modern license & support bundles + rolling upgrade cadence experiment for Private/VPC
creator: Leah Park
description: Run a controlled pricing and packaging experiment for Private/VPC and on-prem customers to validate a two-axis model: (A) annualized license fee bands + optional ops credits; (B) three support tiers (Core, SRE Lite, SRE Plus) paired with rolling upgrade cadence options (Quarterly scheduled, Rolling minor + Escrowed hotfix bundle). Goal is to find a repeatable commercial construct that meets enterprise procurement, reduces sales friction, and aligns upgrade risk with price.
proposal: 1) Offer three license bands: Entry (single-host, lower fee + per-GPU overage), Committed (cluster-level commit with discounted per-GPU), and Enterprise (seatless commit + priority capacity). 2) Support tiers: Core (business hours, best-effort patching), SRE Lite (SLA on response, managed patch window coordination), SRE Plus (24/7 escalations, runbook access, quarterly on-site cadence optional). 3) Upgrade cadences: customers pick a cadence at contract signature; default is Quarterly scheduled upgrades with optional Rolling minor releases for SRE Plus. Escrowed hotfix bundle: a paid add-on for customers needing monthly emergency patch windows and backported security fixes. 4) Security questionnaire mapping: prepopulate standard SQ responses for Core, provide a fast lane for SRE Plus with pre-approved KMS/HSM options and SOC artifacts to shorten procurement.
tradeoffs:
- Higher complexity in quoting vs a single simple SKU.
- Sales friction initially from more options; expect short-term increase in contract review time but lower negotiation cycles for customers who self-select tiers.
- Operational burden if many customers pick different cadences; mitigation: limit Rolling minor releases to SRE Plus and cap number of custom windows per quarter.
- Pricing elasticity unknown for high-compliance customers; need to watch conversion and churn.
acceptance_criteria: A/B cohort of 20 prospects completed contract negotiation within 8 weeks
Conversion uplift of >=10% to committed bands vs baseline offering
Average sales review time not exceeding 30 days for 75% of deals
No critical security questionnaire gaps for SRE Plus tier during pilot
Operational runbook for staggered upgrades validated and exercised in staging
